scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Private Self-Financed Technical Institutions
other_conditions: Institution must be a registered private self‑financed engineering or polytechnic institute in Jharkhand
Institution must have been operational for at least 5 years with audited financial statements
Institution must have AICTE approval and affiliation with the State Board of Technical Education, Jharkhand or a recognized university
Institution must comply with AICTE norms, including qualified faculty and proper infrastructure
At least 60% of seats must be reserved for local students of Jharkhand
Second installment requires two NBA‑accredited courses and third installment requires four NBA‑accredited courses
benefits_summary: Grants up to ₹2 crore for new private engineering institutions, ₹1 crore for new private polytechnics, up to ₹6 crore for existing engineering institutions, and up to ₹3 crore for existing polytechnics, disbursed in three equal installments.
